items.title: ‘BlackSanta’ Malware Activates EDR and AV Killer Before Detonating Payload
items.description: The malware disables antivirus and EDR protections at the kernel level, clearing the path for credential harvesting, system reconnaissance, and eventual data exfiltration. The post ‘BlackSanta’ Malware Activates EDR and AV Killer Before Detonating Payload appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.description: Microsoft on Tuesday released patches for a set of 84 new security vulnerabilities affecting various software components, including two that have been listed as publicly known. items.title: Gogs Vulnerability Enables Attackers to Silently Overwrite Large File Storage Objects
items.description: A critical security flaw has been discovered in a popular open-source, self-hosted Git service, allowing attackers to overwrite Large File Storage (LFS) objects secretly. Tracked as CVE-2026-25921, this maximum-severity vulnerability carries a CVSS 3.1 score of 10.0. It creates a severe risk for software supply-chain attacks. items.title: Microsoft .NET 0-Day Vulnerability Enables Denial-of-Service Attacks
items.description: An emergency security update has been released to address a newly disclosed .NET Framework vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-26127. This security flaw allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to trigger a Denial-of-Service (DoS) condition on the network. With a CVSS score of 7.5, Microsoft has classified the vulnerability as “Important.” It affects multiple versions of .NET across Windows, […]…
